steps_en: Wait for price to enter zone 3,541.2–3,557.2
Only then consider a SELL — do not chase if price has already left the zone
Close a portion at TP1 3,525.8, then move the stop to the entry 3,541.2–3,557.2
Leave the rest for TP2 3,517.4 and TP3 3,506.7 — cancel if price goes through 3,583.5
